description: This file defines the ReadFileTool class, a tool for reading and processing files within a project. It includes methods for parsing parameters, executing file reading with support for line ranges, binary files, images, and text extraction, as well as generating descriptive tool usage strings.

classes.name: ReadFileTool
classes.description: A class extending BaseTool, providing functionality to read files with support for line ranges, binary formats, images, and code definitions, with user interaction for approval and detailed content extraction.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Parses legacy parameters to extract file entries with optional line ranges.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to process file entries: reads files, handles binary/image content, line ranges, and generates formatted output based on protocol.

methods.name: getReadFileToolDescription
methods.description: Generates a descriptive string for the tool usage based on provided parameters or arguments.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Handles partial tool invocation, extracting file path from parameters and prompting user if needed.
